title: APPROVAL OF THE FIRST AMENDMENT TO REVOCABLE PERMIT NO. 23-11 BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES GENERAL SERVICES DEPARTMENT
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - APPROVAL OF THE FIRST AMENDMENT TO REVOCABLE PERMIT NO. 23-11 BETWEEN THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES HARBOR DEPARTMENT AND THE CITY OF LOS ANGELES GENERAL SERVICES DEPARTMENT
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests approval of the First Amendment to Revocable Permit No. 23-11 (RP 23-11) with the City of Los Angeles General Services Department (GSD) for premises located at 826 Eubank Avenue in Wilmington. Under RP 23-11, GSD operates a transitional accommodation facility for unhoused individuals. RP 23-11 is set to expire on February 28, 2027. The proposed First Amendment to RP 23-11 would extend the permit for an additional six months and reduce the required prior notice to exercise the termination option from 120 days to 30 days. GSD informed the Harbor Department that restoration activities may not be completed by the date the RP will expire. Since RP 23-11 does not contain a holdover provision, an extension is required to avoid a contract lapse. All other terms and conditions remain unchanged. This item is not tied to a Strategic Objective as it is purely administrative.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) find that extending Revocable Permit No. 23-11 by six additional months is in the best interest of the City of Los Angeles in order to allow Tenant to complete restoration activities; 3) approve the First Amendment to Revocable Permit No. 23-11 with the City of Los Angeles General Services Department; 4) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to the First Amendment to Revocable Permit No. 23-11; and 5) adopt Resolution No. ___________________.
